name: GATE
intro: GATE accepts a passport-style photograph and a signature within a range of pixel sizes and file sizes, and checks their proportions too.

notes: Colour photo, between 200 × 260 and 530 × 690 pixels, 5–600 KB, JPG.
Plain white background, facing the camera; your face should fill 60–70% of the photo.
documents.label: Photograph

notes: Between 250 × 80 and 580 × 180 pixels, 3–300 KB, JPG. The signature should be about 3 times as wide as it is tall.
Sign in black or dark blue ink; the signature should fill most of the image. No initials or block capitals.
documents.label: Signature

source.label: GATE 2027 photograph and signature guidelines, IIT Madras

faqs.q: What is the GATE photo size?
faqs.a: A colour JPG between 200 × 260 and 530 × 690 pixels and between 5 KB and 600 KB, with a plain white background.

faqs.q: What is the GATE signature size?
faqs.a: A JPG between 250 × 80 and 580 × 180 pixels and between 3 KB and 300 KB, about three times as wide as it is tall.
